sn56.27:1.1: bhikkhave ariyasaccāni kātamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccam || pe || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri ariyasaccāni tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni || tasmā ariyasaccānīti vuccanti || ||
sn56.27:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karāṇiyo ti || ||
